name: 4Cs HD Co.,Ltd.
summary: 4Cs HD Co., Ltd. operates mail order, retail, wholesale and hygiene consultancy businesses in Japan and abroad. Wholesale supplies aromatherapy goods, cosmetics and health supplements through its own stores and drug and general merchandise outlets, while retail focuses on aromatherapy products and essential oils. Dating from 2003 as 4Cs Holdings Co., Ltd., it has its headquarters in Fukuoka City, Japan.
